column1: # FIVE SEPARATE QUESTIONS are answered for every criterion:
#   PATH_PRESENT_IN_CLOSE_TREE  the cited path exists at the close
#   PATH_PRESENT_AT_RELEVANT_PHASE  it existed by the frozen phase
#     description is about the same subject as the frozen criterion
# A criterion is discharged only when the claim is faithful AND the
# witness content carries the subject AND the witness was committed
# by the phase the frozen roster assigns. EXISTENCE ALONE
# A witness from the WRONG phase is chronologically invalid: an
# artifact committed in an EARLIER phase cannot discharge a
# criterion the frozen roster assigns to a LATER phase, and an
# artifact committed AFTER the claimed phase cannot prove it
